$comment: Curated intelligence-index measurements, the reviewed source of truth for scripts/sync-intellect.mts. RULES: (1) values are cited facts — every entry needs a real source and asOf date, never a guess; (2) canonicalVersion is the permanent display scale — it only changes as a deliberate, breaking re-baseline; (3) a model may have one entry per indexVersion (that overlap is what makes it an equating anchor); (4) fitted equating maps are crystallised here by the sync script at first fit and are then reused verbatim — pass --refit to deliberately refit after adding anchors; (5) aliases are alternate id/label forms the same weights appear under across providers (OpenRouter ids, ACP picker labels) — lookup keys only, they never create a second measurement; (6) record only DIRECT measurements of the configuration the index reports — never derive a value by arithmetic from statements about other configurations (a derived Sonnet 4.6 = 53−6 = 47 mixed reasoning efforts and broke the live-feed anchor gate until corrected to the measured 35.9). VERSION NOTE: v4.0 is the pre-renormalisation scale of June 2026 (the cohort where Opus 4.8 = 61, GPT-5.5 = 60); v4.1 is the July 2026 renormalisation (AA article 'Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.1: a shift toward agentic workloads') where the same Opus 4.8 checkpoint reads 56. Never compare raw values across the two.
attribution: Intelligence Index data from Artificial Analysis (https://artificialanalysis.ai)
